metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in the Leipzig mining region (e.g., Neuseenland) increase in April 2020 compared to April 1987?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Landsat 5 for 1987 (TM sensor, operational 1984-2013) - Use Landsat 8 for 2020 (OLI sensor, operational from 2013) - Location: Leipzig mining region/Neuseenland, Germany (~51.3°N, 12.4°E) - Time: April 1987 vs April 2020 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds since we're detecting water - Use water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) to identify water surfaces - MNDWI = (Green - SWIR1) / (Green + SWIR1) is better for water detection 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Water extent in 2020 is less than or equal to 1987 - Valid Positive (A): Water extent in 2020 is greater than 1987 - C1: No images found in one or both periods - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const leipzig = ee.Geometry.Point([12.4, 51.3]); const region = leipzig.buffer(15000); // 15km radius around Leipzig // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Landsat 5 for 1987 let col1987 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1987-04-01', '1987-04-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const count1987 = col1987.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1987 Images: ${count1987}`); if (count1987 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 5 data for April 1987'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Landsat 8 for 2020 let col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2020-04-01', '2020-04-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const count2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Images: ${count2020}`); if (count2020 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 8 data for April 2020'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate MNDWI for water detection function addMNDWI_L5(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2', 'SR_B5']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } function addMNDWI_L8(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } function maskClouds_L5(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask); } function maskClouds_L8(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask); } col1987 = col1987.map(maskClouds_L5).map(addMNDWI_L5); col2020 = col2020.map(maskClouds_L8).map(addMNDWI_L8); const img1987 = col1987.median().select('MNDWI'); const img2020 = col2020.median().select('MNDWI'); // Water threshold: MNDWI > 0 const water1987 = img1987.gt(0); const water2020 = img2020.gt(0); // 4. Check for valid pixels const validPixels1987 = water1987.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); const validPixels2020 = water2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels 1987: ${validPixels1987}`); console.log(`Valid pixels 2020: ${validPixels2020}`); if (validPixels1987 === 0 || validPixels2020 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate water area const waterArea1987 = water1987.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); const waterArea2020 = water2020.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (waterArea1987 === null || waterArea2020 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } const area1987_km2 = waterArea1987 / 1e6; const area2020_km2 = waterArea2020 / 1e6; console.log(`Water area 1987: ${area1987_km2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Water area 2020: ${area2020_km2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Increase: ${(area2020_km2 - area1987_km2).toFixed(2)} km²`); if (area2020_km2 > area1987_km2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
